title: Concept
description: A single concept in Xavier's knowledge graph: definition, domain, relationships, and verification tier.

id.description: Unique slug (kebab-case). Used as a reference key in related_concepts.

domain.description: Primary domain: governance | llm-architecture | ai-metacognition | ai-planning | brewmind | personal

definition.description: Xavier-owned short definition (1-3 sentences). Tier-annotated if not directly Xavier-authored.

aliases.description: Alternate names or abbreviations for this concept.

related_concepts.description: Array of concept ids this concept is related to.

tier.description: Verification tier. A=Xavier-verified, B=credible secondary source, C=model synthesis pending review.

notes.description: Optional context, tensions, or open questions about this concept.
